g.text: Compute playback from tempo and bar lead, then subtract one tick.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Keep the saved completion time fixed and compare it with that cutoff.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Count a miss if it is late, unsuccessful or for the wrong version.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: cf: hypothetical comparison; L: lead bars; j: bar index starting at 0; m: beats/bar.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: r: ticks/beat; B: BPM; f: saved completion timestamp. Missing results count as misses.
